precision: West edge is EXACT: the literal shared east faces of plots 3, 2, 1 and 67&68, whose printed top/bottom widths already shrink row by row (76'-11" -> 74'-2" -> 71'-9" -> 67'-11" -> 67&68's 78'-8"/73'-7"), which is what encodes the road's real diagonal angle in this drawing. East (outer) edge is a nominal 40ft parallel offset -- no road-width dimension is printed for this EXISTING road, so that figure is an approximation, not a measurement.
